what: A DX7 on your FM-1: Yamaha's 256 ROM voices and your own cartridges, with arp, scales, latch and a 16-loop looper. A MIDI controller over USB, Bluetooth and TRS. And the FM-1 as keys, knobs and screen for the RemoteFM1 apps on the web, iOS and Android, which run over 150 FM-1 firmwares.
author: Quixotic7
